_about: Template of model-card.json, the machine-readable card of a Brasa release. Do not fill it by hand: `brasa.evaluate`, `brasa.export` and `brasa.export_onnx` write every section when called with --model-card model-card.json (see README, 'Reproduce'). null marks a value that only exists after the real corpus has been trained on. scripts/render_model_card.py turns the filled file into the Hugging Face model card.

model._about: GPTConfig of the checkpoint plus the parameter count (written by brasa.evaluate from run.json).

training._about: Settings and measurements of the training run.

data._about: Statistics of the data directory. `corpus` is the optional corpus.json of the directory; a rehearsal corpus carries "fictional": true.

evaluation._about: One entry per weight format: float32 (the checkpoint, written by brasa.evaluate), float16 and int8 (the exported weights, written by brasa.export). `headline[mode][seen|val|test]` holds n, em, f1, in_scope_em, in_scope_f1, key_span_recall, refusal_precision, refusal_recall, language_consistency, unsupported_number_rate and, open-book only, retrieval_hit, em_when_gold_retrieved, em_when_gold_missed. `full[mode][split]` holds the same metrics as overall / by_lang / by_kind / by_topic / by_retrieval.

files._about: Size report of the export directory: bytes, gzip -9, brotli -11 and SHA-256 of every file.

quantisation._about: Weight and logit error of each exported format against the float32 checkpoint.
